name: text-slice-glitch
title: Slice Displacement
description: Chữ bị cắt thành 6–8 lát ngang, vài lát giật lệch sang ngang tới 24 px trong 1–3 khung rồi trở lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.chance: a group bursts above this seed (0.25)
options.ghost: opacity of the clean text underneath (0.18)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 6–8 horizontal slices (cut positions jittered ±35 % per burst); in a burst (1–3 frames at 15 fps updates, 50–80 ms) slices with seed > 0.45 shift x by a seeded ±24 px; 18 % ghost of the clean text underneath; bursts only in set windows (e.g. 0.3–1.15 s and 2.25–2.75 s). Demo: 7 slices, steps of 67 ms in groups of 4 (burst if seed > 0.25), the most-shifted slice turns accent; loop 3 s. CSS fallback: 4 band copies, 2.4 s steps, jolt −18 / +11 px at 90 / 92 %. Params: slices: số lát (6–8) · offset: độ lệch (±24 px) · burst: 1–3 khung · rate (15 lần/giây) · seed.
